frozen_boundaries: Existing nonexecuting nominal job frontend and original concurrency/run/retry clauses retained.
SERVICE/ASYNC frozen semantics unchanged; no ordinary mail rewrite, authored private capability grant, general authority widening or cross-HTTP ordinary transaction.
No RM-601/RM-603, whole RM-306, golden or Goal clearance.

document_pin_limit: These are inspection snapshots of concurrently owned documents, not approval of their unrelated content or a claim of end-of-review whole-document stability.

inspection.assessment: Dedicated optional JobReminderDelivery and closed section/term/bound/version structs/enums; order_by is ordered two-element tuple, not semantic set. Public AST cannot use generic expression/map slots to substitute capabilities.

Private parse-only intermediate shapes enforce all five sections and required keys (selection 13, hooks 3, service 6, payload 5, authority 4, completion 3). Duplicate detection independent of successful value parsing; no descriptor returned after any new diagnostic. Reference spelling is lexical/contextual, not semantic-name heuristic. Direct references, closed terms, exact version/500 and two asc cursor fields accepted; invocation/operator/index/record/extra constructor/token suffix rejected.

Bounded balanced recovery observes braces/parens/brackets and stops at safe keys/close/EOF/top declarations. Dot/colon/left-paren lookahead avoids mistaking config.wrong or input.make(...) for declaration headers. Later job/output recovery independently challenged at 39 cut points and four malformed variants.

Optional delivery dispatch retains original three clauses. Duplicate job/descriptor clauses remain invalid; delivery-related top-declaration recovery is scoped to jobs that have encountered delivery, avoiding broad ordinary-job recovery changes.

Canonical section/key ordering only after clean parse, using parsed ranges and raw chunks with attached comments. Nested payload replacements applied in reverse-offset order; no cursor value sorting. Token/comment multiset and idempotence verified. Invalid source is not semantically canonicalized.

TYPE_JOB_DELIVERY_BINDING_NOT_IMPLEMENTED emitted before checked job insertion for every parsed descriptor. No typing.jobs entry or approval subject is derivable from complete delivery candidate. Malformed descriptors fail syntax rather than silently exporting a plain job.
Public diagnostic explains syntax does not establish sealed origins, hooks or phase-qualified authority, and explicitly keeps lowering disabled.
Owning grammar distinguishes syntax-only descriptor from unsupported checked binding. Owning checkpoint records stage-one/focused evidence, not runtime completion.
